name: Wave Function Collapse
desc: An adjacency-constrained wave-function-collapse solver that visibly collapses a grid one lowest-entropy cell at a time, weaving compatible tile-edges into a coherent luminous network of pipes and circuit paths that flows, completes, and regenerates.

density.doc: grid resolution (higher = finer grid, more cells/tiles)

hue.doc: palette base hue (tiles fan out multi-hue from here)
